Sandbox_Crepuscular_NightMode_tooltip: How night is decided. Fixed hours: night runs between the two hours below, every day of the year, whatever the Day/Night Cycle setting. Seasonal night: the game's own dusk and dawn, which move with the seasons and follow the Day/Night Cycle setting (endless day has no night, endless night is always night).
Sandbox_Crepuscular_NightStartHour_toolt: Hour of the day, 0 to 23, at which night begins when Night mode is Fixed hours. Night can run past midnight. If both hours are the same there is no night at all, and the log says so.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_NightEndHour_tooltip: Hour of the day, 0 to 23, at which night ends when Night mode is Fixed hours.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_Day_tooltip: What changes by day while no event runs. Fields are key=value, separated by ;. off=mutants turns The Mutants off: no new mutants, and far ones are removed; off=none turns nothing off. set.Table.Option=value changes a sandbox option, for example set.ZombieLore.Toughness=1, or set.Option=value for an option without a table, for example set.HoursForCorpseRemoval=24; it goes back to its base value when the day ends. say=text shows a line to every player when the day begins (say=@Key shows that translation), and color=rrggbb gives its colour. A sun event starts from these values. A bad field is skipped and logged, and the rest applies.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_Night_tooltip: What changes by night while no event runs, written as for Day: off=mutants or off=none, set.Table.Option=value, say=text and color=rrggbb. The values go back to their base when the night ends. A moon event starts from these values, even when it runs into the day. The default, off=mutants, keeps The Mutants from making mutants at night.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_Events1_tooltip: Moons and suns: special nights and days. Events are separated by |, fields by ;. Each event needs id=name (letters a-z, digits and _) and track=moon (decided when night begins) or track=sun (decided when day begins). Conditions, which must all hold: moon=full (the first night of a full moon; also new, waxingcrescent, firstquarter, waxinggibbous, waninggibbous, thirdquarter, waningcrescent), date=10-31 or date=12-20..01-05, month=6..8, season=summer, every=30 (every 30 days since the world began; every=30+5 shifts it by 5), mindays=30 and maxdays=365 (days since the world began), nth=4 (every 4th time its calendar conditions hold), after=id (the first time after that event ended), cooldown=20d or 36h, weather=rain, snow, storm, fog or clear, tempmin=0 and tempmax=30 (degrees C), chance=50. A list such as moon=full,new holds when any item does. Timing: at=HH:MM starts it later in its night or day, and for=phase (the default), 2p (phases), 6h or 3.5d sets how long it lasts. prio=10: when several events qualify, the highest is tried first. Effects: off, set., say and color, as in Day and Night; a moon starts from Night and a sun from Day. One event runs at a time, and nothing else is decided while it runs. An event with an error is skipped and logged. Keep each option under 32000 bytes.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_Events2_tooltip: More events, written as in Events 1. The option an event is in only matters between events with the same prio: earlier ones are tried first.

Sandbox_Crepuscular_MutantKeepDistance_t: While mutants are off (off=mutants), a mutant is removed only if it has no target and no player is within this many tiles of it, in a straight line. 0 to 300. Keep it beyond what players can see, or mutants vanish in view.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_MutantRemovalsPerMin: Most mutants removed per in-game minute, 1 to 500. Every player's game is told to remove its copy of each one.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_MutantRequeue_toolti: Only matters when The Mutants is loaded. On: when mutants come back on (the definition in effect no longer has off=mutants), the zombies already loaded are offered to The Mutants, up to 200 per in-game minute, so the ones it picks turn into mutants at once. Some may change in plain view. Off: The Mutants only looks at a zombie when it is next created or loaded.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_ExcludedOutfits_tool: Outfit names of other mods' monsters, or the start of them, separated by commas, for example MyMonsters_,Cultist. Upper and lower case don't matter. When The Mutants is loaded, zombies wearing these outfits are never turned into mutants, and Crepuscular never removes them. Monsters of Cry of Fear Monster NPCs are never turned into mutants either. The outfit is read from the zombie's saved outfit, so it also works before the zombie is dressed.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_Verbose_tooltip: Writes phase changes, each decision with its rolls, event starts and ends, sandbox value changes, mutant removals and requeues to the log, prefixed [Crepuscular]. Warnings and errors, such as mistakes in the definitions, are always logged.
